title: Ownership after olla: several owners
summary: Name several owners after olla: Kirja on lasten (“The book is the children's”).
objectives: Name several owners after olla: Kirja on lasten (“The book is the children's”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A genitive after olla can identify who owns something. The verb agrees with the thing owned, not with the owner.
All subjects here are singular: Kirja on … and Auto on … . The ownership expression comes after on.
Use these ownership forms: lapsi → lasten/lapsien, nainen → naisten/naisien, opettaja → opettajien, opiskelija → opiskelijoiden/opiskelijoitten.
keyPoints: Use the genitive for the owner after on.

commonMistakes: Use the genitive for the owner after on.
Do not change on because of the owner's number.
A dictionary-form person noun would describe identity instead of ownership.
